pud_setback_standards.finding: Palm Bay PUD setbacks are NOT fixed numeric values in the code. Per Section 173.068, setbacks must be 'compatible with surrounding existing development' and 'in compliance with the underlying zoning requirements portrayed in the PDP.' The actual PUD ordinance for Sandy Pines Preserve defines the setbacks.
pud_setback_standards.pud_height_limit: No structure shall exceed 200 ft unless Council approves (Sec. 173.068). Underlying RM-15 limits to 40 ft.
pud_setback_standards.pud_open_space: Minimum 25% of gross site acreage dedicated to common recreation and open space (Sec. 173.070). Parking, roads, minimum yards, and building spacing do NOT count toward open space.

rm15_fallback_standards.note: Used as fallback baseline since PUD ordinance not yet obtained and HDR FLU aligns with RM-15

setbacks.front: 25 ft minimum, OR building height, whichever is greater
setbacks.side_interior: 15 ft minimum, OR building height, whichever is greater
setbacks.side_corner: 25 ft minimum, OR building height, whichever is greater
setbacks.rear: 25 ft minimum, OR building height, whichever is greater

rm20_reference_standards.setbacks: Identical to RM-15 (front 25/height, side 15/height, corner 25/height, rear 25/height)
rm20_reference_standards.height_variation_rule: Buildings 4+ stories: 15% of roofline must have 10-ft height variation

multifamily_facade_standards.up_to_100ft_length: At least 15% of facade must vary by at least 5 ft
multifamily_facade_standards.over_100ft_length: 2+ portions must vary by at least 5 ft, totaling at least 15%

north_tract_d.reason: Away from road, adjacent to preserve

setbacks_by_height_scenario.note: RM-15 rule: setback = MAX(minimum, building_height). At 3+ stories, building height controls all setbacks except possibly front.

buildable_envelope.method: Setback offsets from each boundary, then intersect with wellhead easement exclusion zone

gross_buildable_setbacks_only.note: Area remaining after setbacks, BEFORE wellhead easement exclusion

net_buildable_with_wellhead.note: Area remaining after BOTH setbacks AND wellhead easement (47% west exclusion). Building zone is trapezoidal in eastern portion of parcel — wider at south (road frontage), narrowing north due to wellhead arc.

parking_in_wellhead_zone.note: Parking IS permitted within the wellhead easement zone (survey annotates 'PARKING' there). Only buildings/structures are prohibited. 10-ft parking setback from property lines applies.

density_calculations.note: Density is calculated from gross parcel area, NOT net buildable area. PUD ordinance controls actual permitted density.

open_space_requirement.assessment: The wellhead easement zone (22,803 sf), if designated as passive recreation/open space with landscaping and trails, can satisfy the entire 25% open space requirement. However, any portion used for parking does NOT count toward open space.
open_space_requirement.parking_vs_open_space_tradeoff: Must balance parking needs (min ~63 spaces needed for 16-22 units) against open space requirements. May need to designate some wellhead zone as open space and locate all parking on remainder.

three_story_35ft_scenario.typical_building_footprint_8_units: 4,000 - 5,000 sf (8 units × 900 sf avg ÷ 3 floors = ~2,400 sf/floor + corridors/stairs)

four_story_40ft_scenario.typical_building_footprint_12_units: 3,000 - 4,000 sf (12 units × 900 sf avg ÷ 4 floors = ~2,700 sf/floor + corridors/stairs)

building_footprint_feasibility.note: Actual unit count depends on PUD ordinance density cap, unit size mix, and building code requirements (egress, ADA, fire separation).

critical_caveats: PUD ordinance controls actual setbacks — these RM-15 values are fallback estimates
The building-height-equals-setback rule severely limits buildable area at 3-4 stories
Wellhead easement boundary positions (125 ft at north, 85 ft at south from NW corner) are approximate — precise survey needed
Lot coverage maximum not explicitly codified for RM-15 multifamily — governed by setbacks + open space + parking
Curved front setback follows concentric arc at R=1011.12 ft (original R minus 25 ft) — ~0.5 ft sagitta difference, negligible
